classification: Additive RWA v2 sequenced semantic assessments and fail-closed execution hardening; no production activation
receiptImpact: Adds distinct v2 EIP-712 domain with sequence, predecessor digest, admitted calldata semantics and receiver evidence. Preserves v1 signed bytes and every existing partner policy/activation. Shared uint256 schema and detailed verification are hardened; shared RWA sources and frozen vectors are content-pinned in CI.
activationRule: No partner activation changes. RWA is explicit opt-in with consumer-pinned policy and keys. Caller-supplied diagnostics cannot authorize execution. Fixtures are simulation-only; production requires independently authenticated licensed feeds, instrument halt/corporate-action and issuer evidence plus reviewed signer operations.
